description: This file defines the UserSessionListener interface in the org.openmrs package, which is used to track user login and logout events, including their status, within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: UserSessionListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to user session events such as login and logout, and their outcomes.

methods.name: loggedInOrOut
